Andaa Salan

.cook

Add however much andaa and aloo you want. For scaling to multiple people it isn't an exact 1:1 scale up but as you make it you will figure out how much you need for how many people

📖 s.samsungfood.com

🥘 Ingredients

  • egg
    2
  • fried onion
    1 tablespoon
  • garlic paste
    1 teaspoon
  • ginger paste
    1 teaspoon
  • ground coriander
    1/2 teaspoon
  • ground cumin
    1/2 teaspoon
  • oil
  • potato
    1
  • red chili powder
    1/2 teaspoon
  • salt
  • tomato sauce
    1/2 cup
  • turmeric
    1/2 teaspoon
  • water
    1/2 cup

🍳 Cookware

  • pot
  • pan
  1. 1
    Boil egg and potato in a pot .
    egg: 2, potato: 1
  2. 2
    Measure out fried onion , garlic paste , ginger paste , red chili powder , turmeric , ground cumin , and ground coriander .
    fried onion: 1 tablespoon, garlic paste: 1 teaspoon, ginger paste: 1 teaspoon, red chili powder: 1/2 teaspoon, turmeric: 1/2 teaspoon, ground cumin: 1/2 teaspoon, ground coriander: 1/2 teaspoon
  3. 3
    Add everything to a pan and cook until the individual scents disappear and khushboo (good smell) comes, ⏱️ 10-15 minutes . Add water as needed so it doesn't burn and oil as needed so it fries. Add salt to taste and stir frequently.
    water, oil, salt
  4. 4
    Add tomato sauce and cook for ⏱️ 5-10 minutes until the tomato has cooked out. Add oil as needed.
    tomato sauce: 1/2 cup, oil
  5. 5
    Add around water and cook for ⏱️ 5 minutes .
    water: 1/2 cup
  6. 6
    Cut the boiled egg and potato and add into the salan. Mix and turn off the heat. Add salt to taste.
    egg, potato, salt
